items.title: John Heard interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Have you got any more questions, Mike?

ctx.x: There’s nothing like it, it’s just what I play. I’m not in the industry, you know, I play this music. This works just fine. If it ain’t broke, don’t mess with it. Right? Because I try to get out of the way as much as possible.
Have you got any more questions, Mike?

I just would like to ask you if you wanted to leave a word with students that you knew would be watching this interview, things that you could tell them about music, to put the magic in it, what would you tell them? ©Fillius Jazz Archive -8-
